title: Book Three · Chapter 7: The Second Lap
story:
On Friday, Ronan takes his water bottle to the field.

Anna is already there with her friend. The two girls stand beside the bench. Anna is tying her hair back.

“One lap?” she asks Ronan.

“One.”

“We are doing two.”

Ronan looks around the track.

“You can have my second one.”

Anna laughs. Her friend puts a bottle under the bench, out of the sun.

They start together. Soon the girls move ahead. Ronan lets the gap grow. On the first day, he tried to follow Anna's feet. Today he looks toward the next white line.

His shoes make a steady sound. At the far turn, he feels hot. He slows down, but he keeps his feet moving.

Anna reaches the bench and starts her second lap. Her friend follows close behind.

Ronan has half a turn left. He runs to the end and stops beside his bottle.

He wants to sit down at once. He walks a little first. Then he sits on the bench and drinks.

Across the field, the girls pass the far side.

A boy comes over from the grass.

“Are you finished?” he asks.

“Yes.”

“Good. Can I sit?”

Ronan moves his bottle. The boy sits at the other end. There is grass on one knee.

“Football?” Ronan asks.

“Mostly falling down.”

The boy brushes his knee. More grass falls onto his shoe.

Ronan looks at his own shoes. One lace is loose again. He bends down and ties it.

“That lace doesn't like school,” the boy says.

“It tries to leave every day.”

They watch a ball move across the field. Someone shouts. The boy stands up.

“They need me.”

“For football or falling down?”

“Both.”

He runs back to the grass.

Anna and her friend come around the last turn. Anna's arms move more slowly now. Her friend reaches the bench first.

“You can have my third lap,” Ronan says.

Anna puts her hands on her knees.

“Keep it.”

Her friend laughs, then takes a long drink.

The three of them rest. Anna asks her friend about a lesson. Ronan listens for a while. Then he watches the game on the grass.

When the bell rings, he stands up without a groan.

“Better today?” Anna asks.

“I ran all the way.”

“I saw you at the far turn.”

They collect their bottles. Her friend goes ahead to meet another girl near the steps.

Ronan walks beside Anna. Neither of them runs for the bell.

At the classroom door, he looks down. His laces are still tied.

He raises one foot a little.

“It stayed.”

Anna looks at the shoe and nods seriously.

“A good student.”
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

gap＝间隔、距离；steady＝平稳的；knee＝膝盖；all the way＝从头到尾、全程。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan这次跑步和第一天相比，怎样改变了速度安排？
2. Anna和她的朋友跑了几圈？Ronan有没有因此增加自己的圈数？

## 读句子

**Ronan lets the gap grow.**

拆开看：Ronan / lets / the gap grow.

Ronan／任由／彼此的距离变大。
